messages:
maya: Cutting RC now — prepping a promo for 2026-03-21 18:00 PT. Pinning artifact sha: abc1f3e. No DB migrations.
alex: ack. which services changed?
sam: inference-api, embeddings-service, console UI. config-only for console.
maya: pinned rc name: rc-2026-03-21-1 -> image=gcr/redwood/inference@sha256:abc1f3e
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] RC created: rc-2026-03-21-1 by maya
    artifacts: image=gcr/redwood/inference@sha256:abc1f3e
    checks: build=PASS, unit=PASS, smoke=PASS
maya: plan: canary 5% for 20m, then 25% for 30m, then full. KV-warm during canary.
olivia: dashboard: https://dash.redwood.local/rcs/rc-2026-03-21-1 (perf + errors)
sam: recommend fallback policy -> model-quant-v2 if p95>500ms or 5xx spikes.
alex: set routing policy: fallback_model=model-quant-v2 ; route_priority=stable->canary->fallback
maya: @oncall-sheriff are you available for promo window? thresholds: 5xx>0.5% OR p95>500ms triggers rollback.
oncall-sheriff: oncall here, will monitor. ack thresholds. add me to incident channel :eyes: 
maya: rollback play (short): 1) /run rollback rc-2026-03-21-1 (deploy-bot) 2) pin previous rc rc-2026-03-18-3 3) notify customers via status page
alex: rollback script in repo: ops/rollback_rc.sh --rc rc-2026-03-21-1 (we tested it in dry-run)
sam: release notes PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/987 — callouts: batching improvements, kv-cache warm, quantization tweaks (embed side).
olivia: adding note about temporary perf regression risk on high-batch embed requests.
maya: need final SRE/QA sign-off by 17:30 PT. QA please confirm smoke + sec scan.
alex: QA finished. sec-scan ok. smoke ok at 17:22 PT.
oncall-sheriff: give green at 17:45 PT if no late regressions.
maya: green from product and infra. promote when window opens.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Promotion scheduled: rc-2026-03-21-1 -> start=2026-03-21T18:00:00Z window=60m change_window=18:00-19:00PT
deploy-bot: /promote rc-2026-03-21-1 initiated: starting canary (5%)
deploy-bot: canary slice assigned to infra-canary-pool
sam: canary logs look clean, p95 ~120ms, 0 errors so far.
olivia: telemetry evals show no quality regressions on the curated prompt set.
oncall-sheriff: monitoring 10m in — all good :thumbsup:
maya: kick off KV warm job: ./ops/warm_kv.sh --target rc-2026-03-21-1 --concurrency 4
deploy-bot: canary -> schedule to move to 25% at 2026-03-21T18:20:00Z
sam: moving to 25% now per schedule.
--- 8m later ---
alex: alert: embeddings-service p95 spiking to 610ms for a subset of requests (batched path).
oncall-sheriff: seeing it too, correlated to high batch size from bulk client. opening triage.
maya: immediate mitigation: revert route for embeddings-service to previous RC (rc-2026-03-18-3) and pause further promotion.
deploy-bot: [deploy-bot] Executing rollback: /rollback rc-2026-03-21-1 by maya
deploy-bot: rollback steps: 1) shift traffic to rc-2026-03-18-3 2) drain canary pool 3) mark rc-2026-03-21-1 as FAILED
deploy-bot: rollback complete. traffic restored to rc-2026-03-18-3.
sam: post-rollback notes: likely quantization/packing issue when batch_size>8 on embed model. reproducing locally.
olivia: updated PR notes and added a hotfix branch. PR #987 updated with fallback & test vectors.
maya: closing promo window early. we'll re-cut rc after hotfix and an additional tuning pass. thanks all — good run on automation and quick rollback.
oncall-sheriff: filing incident ticket: INC-2026-03121-1 for postmortem.
alex: follow-up actions: 1) add batch-size guarding in router 2) add regression test for quantized embed path 3) schedule a re-cut next Tuesday.
maya: agreed. will create a checklist and schedule. closing thread.
